items.title: Bitcoin miners pay Paraguay $350 million a year, but AI is pushing them out
items.summary: Contracts that sell power to a 4% slice of the world's bitcoin mining at $44 a megawatt-hour expire on Dec. 31, 2027. Paraguay's state utility calls the date final, and it has just signed a 15-year deal to power a Founders Fund-backed AI campus.

items.title: Dormant Bitcoin Wallets Wake Up After 16 Years, Moving $6.9 Million
items.summary: Two Bitcoin mining rewards from September 2010 moved minutes apart. The coins are worth nearly 1.15 million times their original market value.

items.title: Bitcoin plunges to $68,000 as Anthropic IPO frenzy adds to market jitters
items.summary: Analysts see no direct link between Nvidia and bitcoin's decline, pointing instead to investor capital headed into Anthropic as well as a broader risk-off move.

items.title: Fed Chair Warsh Wants Answers on AI Inflation–and Bitcoin May Feel the Impact
items.summary: The Federal Reserve is examining whether AI will lower prices or keep inflation elevated, a question that could shape interest rates and the outlook for crypto.
